collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TALL TALES AND SELF-INTEREST (TT-01 to TT-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Boasting, stretched stories, little vanities, wanting the credit, the best seat or the bigger half. Most of it is harmless and funny; kind people can be boastful too. Nobody is exposed for the sake of it, and nobody needs a lesson.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)
the owner (2026-11-15): a person named by a role word is a cast villager and shows the name (flavor only: the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A villager waits behind a tree to sweep into the festival in a new cape: make the entrance, or give up and walk in.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a new feathered cape for the festival, and wants everyone to see it. So (subject.he/she) has decided not to arrive with everyone else. (subject.He/she) will wait until the dancing has started and then sweep in. (subject.He/she) is now standing behind a tree at the edge of the festival, waiting for the perfect moment. It has been a long time.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) gets bored of waiting and simply walks in. In the crowd, nobody notices the cape at all. Then, much later, sitting quietly by the fire, (subject.he/she) hears (friend) say, "Where did you get that cape? It's beautiful." It's the only compliment (subject.he/she) gets all night. It turns out to be enough.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: At last (subject) sweeps in, cape flowing behind (subject.him/her), at exactly the moment the drummers stop and everyone turns toward the food. Nobody looks. Then (child), a child, shouts, "Ooh, a CAPE!" and the whole festival turns round. (subject) gets a round of applause, which was all (subject.he/she) wanted, and twice what (subject.he/she) expected.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only
